title: When You Just Outran Deputies 3 Times Then Casually Walk Down the Road
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 28, 2022, a 23-year-old male was able to elude Marathon County Sheriff’s deputies three times in Knowlton, WI. Initially, they were dispatched to a residence for the report of a male in crisis. Deputies were advised the male had an active warrant and located him at a dead-end. He fled and stopped at a nearby intersection momentarily but continued on, leading deputies on a pursuit for several miles. At another intersection, he crashed into a stop sign and was hit by a semi-truck. He continued to flee but ultimately crashed into a cornfield and fled on foot. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
